blocks.packageReason: Package, justified (see the header). Only user: Home Run (n = 3, stages = 1), nothing to bind. Suspected game bugs, NOT fixed: (1) the once-per-turn memory is a Symbol property written on the Pokemon object with the battle's turn NUMBER, which is never cleared, so a Pokemon that landed a crit on turn 3 of one battle is blocked on turn 3 of the next battle (a party member survives between waves); (2) the crit is read from the TARGET's `attacksReceived[0]`, the first hit the target took this turn, which in doubles or after an ally hit first may be somebody else's hit; (3) a dead code block reads `attacksReceived[0]` of the holder and does nothing. The L1 grid and the L2 twin cannot see the turn memory, so the B10 test (test/tests/elite-redux/decomp/B10/on-crit-stat-boost-lowest.test.ts) drives canApply and apply on the original and the rebuild.

blocks.packageReason: Package, justified (see the header). Users (5 attrs): Haunted Spirit (cursed attacker, not against Ghost), Vengeful Spirit (the same), Guilt Trip (attacker Attack -2 and Sp. Atk -2, its allies -1 each), Ill Will (drain PP) and Cursed Spirit (inherits the Haunted Spirit part); nothing to bind. The text codec round-trips every live payload (checked by the B10 test, test/tests/elite-redux/decomp/B10/on-faint-effect.test.ts). set-weather, set-terrain, set-hazard are not used by a live ability today but are declared and covered by the codec test. Oddities, not fixed: a lasting effect written without 'for N turns' lasts until lifted (the class treats a missing number as 0); the hazard payload is added to the side opposite the fainting Pokemon even when the attacker is on the same side as the fainter.
